name: Web search
about: Lets the model search the web through your SearXNG instance when it is unsure or the answer needs recent information. What the model searches for comes from the chat and leaves this PC for that instance; the searches a reply made are shown with it.

tool.note: Today's date is {today}. What you know may be out of date: for anything recent, or anything that may have changed, search the web with web_search before you answer.

settings.name: url
settings.label: SearXNG address
settings.help: http(s)://host[:port][/path], with the JSON format on (its settings.yml: search.formats lists json).

settings.name: results
settings.label: Results per search
settings.help: What the model gets from each search (1-10).

settings.name: timeout_s
settings.label: Time limit (seconds)
settings.help: Each network step of a search (5-120 s).
